_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-08. CardID = 17600 + idx; 348 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, index 48). The deck object of the save holds 31 cards: the 30 of the deck plus the character card, which is why the catalog says card_count 31 and card_ids [348, 17629]. Her deck is sheet 176 like Medusa's, the four turtles', Doctor Strange's, Bigfoot's and the Marvel decks': only deck.identity (data/tts/jill-trent.json) tells the decks apart (docs/card-identity.md).

Restriction band (JILL TRENT, DAISY or ANY) and copies (xN printed on each card) read from the images; type, value, boost and text of the 13 titles agree with unmatched-memory (memory slug dr-jill-trent). Slug in this project: jill-trent (catalog slug dr-jill-trent-science-sleuth); fighter ids jill and daisy.

Hero card (read from the image): DR. JILL TRENT, MELEE, START HEALTH 13, MOVE 2; special ability GADGETOLOGY: 'At the start of your turn, activate one of your gadgets.' and 'Whenever Jill Trent attacks, resolve the active gadget's effect.' Sidekick DAISY, MELEE, START HEALTH 6 (the card prints the move once, 2, for both). One Daisy. The two gadgets are not on the character card; their texts (Hypnoray Blaster, Ultrabiotic Tonic) come from unmatched-memory and are in the effects file.
